purpose: Independent reconstruction of the PIREUS bilinear-phase atlas and classification of an operator construction.

algebra.gauge: basis-sign q:F2^4->F2 with q(0)=0, acting by delta q(i,j)=q(i)^q(j)^q(i^j)

declared.class_invariant: Q_B(x)=x^T B x, ten independent bits

classification.novelty_rule: an operator construction is novel relative to the v1 lowering grammar when its affine class is not among the classes that grammar reaches
classification.tensor_provenance: the tensor is derived from the construction; no tensor or hash is accepted from a proposer

claim_boundary.statement: locating a construction in the atlas establishes its equivalence class under the declared equivalence and nothing else; scientific novelty, material realisability and performance are separate obligations
